annotations.title: Publish a new version of the person's schema

description: Publishes the next version of one of the person's own schemas (from get_schema, where mine is true), kept private. Give the whole schema with its new version: the same major version with minor + 1 to add optional fields or loosen one, so every track on it keeps working; major + 1 for a change that breaks hacks or sheets (removing a field, making one required), then upgrade_track moves each track. TrackerHacker refuses a version that breaks its contract without a new major. Making a schema public or shared with a team is the person's tap in the app.

schema.description: The whole schema: id, name, description, version, minor, patch and fields.
